exposure: Head circumference (HC) Z-score at 24+0 to 30+6 weeks' gestation
Abdominal circumference (AC) Z-score at 34+0 to 41+6 weeks
cohort: 660 women with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) and singleton pregnancies
finding: A clinical model using pre-pregnancy BMI, HC Z-score at 24+0 to 30+6 weeks' gestation, and AC Z-score at 34+0 to 41+6 weeks was developed and internally validated to predict fetal overgrowth in Korean women with GDM, which showed relatively good performance (AUC: 0.925).
